title: A planted test proves close and drop prune the reopen refs of removed items and keep those of live items
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-matmvkn6, item ST-ihtjygip (Sprint close and drop delete the refs/kb-reopened ref of each item they remove): no test names kb-reopened or prune_reopened_refs, so removing the call in cmd_close (_tools/bl_land.py) or cmd_drop (_tools/bl_items.py) passes every gate; ST-ihtjygip's check read only the clone's ref state, which the worker pruned by calling the function by hand. One planted-failure test in _tools/test_land_e2e.py, within the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json, runs close or drop in an isolated git repo and asserts a removed item's ref is gone, a live item's ref kept, and a drop inside a sprint prunes nothing.
